text:
joan: Heads-up: Pacific change window opens in 30m. This is the planned micro-release (v4.0.1) with the embeddings cache fix. Need final signoff, freeze notes, and a super short rollback playbook.

sam: I'm +1 on the release but want canary-only traffic for first 20m. We should also gate larger traffic shifts on the feature flag parity check.

lee: Can confirm the release note blurb: "v4.0.1: embeddings cache eviction fixes; mitigates cache staleness on long-tail requests. No schema changes." I'll push it to the release repo now.

product-lead: Add a short customer-facing note about transient double-embedding results for EU customers last week and that this release addresses it. Keep it subtle.

joan: Good. Freeze rules: no config changes during quiet window except explicit FF toggles and emergency rollbacks. If emergency rollback triggered, hold all changes for 2h.

sam: Smoke checklist (short):
- prod-smoke: /ops/smoke_prod.sh --fast
- run 20 embedding samples across model sizes
- check embedding similarity drift dashboard (last 1h)
- quick end-to-end gen on main app path

lee: deploy-bot, can you start the canary pin? I want audit logs for compliance.

deploy-bot: @lee acknowledged. Command: `/deploy pin --env=canary --version=v4.0.1 --reason="pacific window canary"`
Pinning in progress...

deploy-bot: Pin complete. Canary -> v4.0.1. Audit id: dbpin-1749001145.

joan: Sam, deploy the canary traffic gate at 5% when ready. We'll hold for 20m and then do a slow ramp if stable.

sam: Starting shift: `/deploy shift --to=canary --pct=5`

sre-oncall: Monitoring: I set ephemeral alerts for p99 > 800ms, overall error rate > 0.4% delta vs baseline. I'll post baseline at +10m.

lee: Quick note on rollback heuristics:
- immediate rollback if 3+ downstream service 5xx increases correlated with new traces
- or if similarity drift > 4% on embedding spot-checks
- or customer error surface > 0.8% (product judgement)

product-lead: If it's marginal, prefer FF toggle first: `ffctl set embeddings_cache_v2 off --env=canary` to avoid customer-visible rollback.

joan: Who will execute rollback? Assigning owners now. Lee -> execute FF toggle if safe. Sam -> execute full rollback command if toggle doesn't help within 6m. SRE -> coordinate traffic and DB pin-unwind.

sam: Copy. My rollback command is: `/deploy rollback --to-version=v4.0.0 --reason="canary regression"`

sre-oncall: Playbook snippet I'll follow:
1) Pause traffic shift
2) Pin stable back to v4.0.0 if requested
3) Disable canary route in LB for affected region
4) Notify #incidents and escalate if >1% user impact

lee: Running prod-smoke now, posting results.

lee: Smoke finished: 20/20 embeddings OK, median latency 180ms, p95 260ms. No similarity drift seen.

joan: Looks green. We'll wait 20m then consider 25% ramp to canary. Reminder: lock release notes edits for the window.

deploy-bot: Canary holdpoint created at 1749001180. Use `/deploy shift --to=canary --pct=25` to continue.

sam: 10m into canary: metrics stable. Proceeding to 25% now.

sre-oncall: Posting baselines: error rate delta +0.02%, p99 steady at 790ms. Still within thresholds.

lee: Preparing FF toggle just in case: `ffctl set embeddings_cache_v2 off --env=canary --reason="rollback mitigation"` — will not run unless we see the pre-defined signals.

joan: Final reminders:
- quiet window policy enforced 
- only short status updates in this channel during window ([INFO], [ALERT], [ROLLBACK])
- any rollback must include a one-line justification and the audit id

product-lead: I'll hold customer comms ready to post if we see degradation.

sam: All set from infra. Will run rollback command if instructed.

lee: Standing by.

sre-oncall: Monitoring in real-time. Will post at +5m intervals.
